info.description: Automate your firm management with the Pennylane Firm Group API.

get.description: This endpoint returns basic information about the token user.

permitted_authentication_methods.description: List of authentication methods which can be used by your firm's users. An authentication method indicates how the user will connect on Pennylane. This requires synchronization with the Pennylane tech-team beforehand to setup various SSO SAML providers. Once the setup is done, the authentication methods will be available to use when creating / updating an user. An user can only have a single authentication method.

post.description: This endpoint allows you to create a new company associated with your firm.

firm_id.description: The firm the company is attached to. A "firm" can be seen as a physical office, where companies are split per locations. So for example "Accounting Firm Paris", "Accounting Firm Montpellier". The firms are created by Pennylane and cannot be created using the API. To list all the available firms, there is an endpoint available List all firms.

reg_no.description: Company's registration number. For French companies, accepts SIREN (9 digits) or SIRET (14 digits). If the company has no registration number yet, set the `not_yet_registered` to true. A pending registration number will be issued, under the form `pending-{UUID}`

not_yet_registered.description: If the company has no registration number yet, `not_yet_registered` should be true and the `reg_no` field left empty

id.description: You can use your own id when creating a company. If not provided, Pennylane will pick one for you (GUID format). The ID must be unique

trade_name.description: Company's commercial name (will be used for customer invoices / emails)

accounting_supervisor_id.description: Company accounting supervisor ID (Chef de Mission)

vat_day_of_month.description: VAT day of month deadline setting

accounting_type.description:
Specifies the accounting methodology that the company will use.
  * `accrual` - Accrual accounting (default)
  * `cash_based` - Cash based accounting

number_of_employees.description: Number of employees. The field presence is mandatory when the saas_plan of the company is `v1_basic`, `v1_essential`, `v1_pro`, or `v1_pro_internalized`.

allOf.description: Maximum number of users for the company. The field is optional. When present, it has to be `1` when the saas_plan of the company is `v1_starter` and it has to be `unlimited` when the saas_plan of the company is `v1_saas_free` or `v1_electronic_invoicing`.

e_invoicing_only.description: This attribute is DEPRECATED, please use `saas_plan` instead. If true, creates the company on the electronic invoicing only (`v1_electronic_invoicing`) plan

saas_plan.description:
The Pennylane SaaS plan for the company.
Takes precedence over the DEPRECATED `e_invoicing_only` attribute.
When not specified:
  - If the DEPRECATED `e_invoicing_only` attribute is `true`, defaults to `v1_electronic_invoicing`
  - If a default SaaS plan is configured on your Firm setting, that plan is used
  - Otherwise, defaults to `v1_saas_free`

business_segmentation.description: Business segmentation of the company. Required if enforced at firm group level.

post.description:
Creates webhook subscriptions for firms in the firm group.

By default, subscriptions are created for every firm currently in the
group. If the given URL is already used by any firm in the group, the
request fails with 422.

When `add_missing_firms=true`, the URL may already exist: subscriptions
are created only for firms that do not yet have that URL. The response
contains only the newly created subscriptions. If every firm already
has that URL, the response is 200 with an empty array. Existing
subscriptions for that URL are left unchanged (including their events
and active flag).

parameters.name: add_missing_firms
parameters.description:
When true, create subscriptions only for firms in the group that do
not already have the given URL, instead of rejecting the request if
the URL is already used.

active.description: Defines if the subscription is active or not

200.description:
Returned only when `add_missing_firms=true` and every firm in the
group already has a subscription for the given URL. Body is an
empty array.

active.description: Defines if the subscription is active or not

secret.description: Secret used to sign the webhook

201.description:
Webhook subscriptions were created. When `add_missing_firms=true`,
only newly created subscriptions are returned.
